```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

0.4 起旧名不再导出。查询替换名：

```{r}
library(bulkMAE)
bulkmae_rename("run_gsva")
bulkmae_rename("run_go_ora")
```

完整对照表见随包指南
`system.file("guides", "naming-migration-zh.md", package = "bulkMAE")`。

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
guide <- system.file("guides", "naming-migration-zh.md", package = "bulkMAE")
if (!nzchar(guide)) {
  guide <- file.path("..", "inst", "guides", "naming-migration-zh.md")
}
lines <- readLines(guide, encoding = "UTF-8")
# Drop the duplicated H1; the vignette title already names the page.
if (length(lines) && startsWith(lines[[1L]], "# ")) {
  lines <- lines[-1L]
}
cat(lines, sep = "\n")
```
